But in the end, we managed to do it, and now we can find solace. Remember how those idiots cursed us? They said, "Go to hell, you worthless traitors!" Heh...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: "The decaying human heart finds rebirth only within the calmness," proclaimed the new master.
Well, I don't know if they really meant it, but if longing for freedom means going to hell...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Then I'll be joining you soon, you old fool.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Let's get together and have supper again in hell...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Oh, I almost forgot. There's one more thing...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: We won't back down either.
Here's to you, a glass of "Hello and Goodbye"... [Trailblazer]...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: But he's such a gentleman. If evil, why so nice?
To the imperfect... tomorrow.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: I flexed too hard with my swag. Guess I now have to pay my dues, huh...
It's warm here, isn't it? You're lucky to have found shelter from the rain, let alone fresh berries, in this desolate place.
I was just following the scent of life. It's particularly strong in a place like this.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It's a shame these berries don't have much flavor.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Seriously? In case you didn't know, this fruit is pretty juicy. The only downside is that when you chew it...
...It becomes extremely spicy.
Have you... lost your sense of taste?
I can still taste certain things... like a faint sweetness.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Before coming here, I stopped by a place called Orkron. It had barren cliffs and nights lit by bonfires. Burgundy snow would fall from the sky, and when it landed on my tongue... it tasted like raspberries.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The flavor wasn't exactly sweet, but it left a lasting impression. When I think back on my past, I realize that what's tying everything together... isn't the big events, but rather these small yet unforgettable moments.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Don't worry about it. Losing oneself is a reality that every Self-Annihilator must face. At least, I haven't completely lost my senses and memories yet.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Well, congratulations on adding another footnote to your journey.
By the way, are you always alone?
No, I had a companion in Orkron. She's a short Nameless girl who aspired to explore IX... She always said she'd walk a path "deeper and farther than Akivili's."
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Quite an ambition for such a small girl... So, what happened?
She... became stagnant water.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Well... my condolences.
Condolences? I don't need them. The girl left with a smile. She never regretted her choice and most definitely wanted me to say goodbye with a smile... So that's what I did.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That's proof that you're grieving for her.
Or perhaps I'm just afraid?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Afraid? I rarely sense that emotion from you. What do you fear?
I'm afraid I'll forget the thirty days I spent with her, just like all the other days in my life. Most of them have already washed away with the rain, disappearing into an unseen realm.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I fear that those vivid red memories will fade away too. There isn't much color left, and besides this faint, warm red, there's almost nothing.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Hard to imagine... a "Ranger" accustomed to bloodshed, destruction, and chaos finding warmth in the red color.

Because I have experienced this warmth many times. Long ago, I promised someone that I'd bring it to more people, and that for every remaining moment of my life, I'd strive for... a better ending for all.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: As long as this red color still lingers, I have a chance to fulfill that promise. It represents a burning fire, a blooming flower, the berries in this cave... and life itself, fleeting yet still dazzling.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: In the end, it will lead me beyond the Horizon of Existence, and on the other side, I will... cut off Nihility.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The one blessed by the sleeping and shapeless is considering how to kill THEM? That's truly... pure Nihility.
But you're right about one thing — After spending so much time near this stagnant water, only when I look at this vibrant red fire do I realize that I'm still alive.
When will this rain... ever stop?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Perhaps... when the sorrows of the departed have finally quieted down, the sky will clear up.

Have you heard of a planet named Byari Skamandros, Dan Heng? It's one of the paradises under the influence of the Harmony, a sought-after wonderland for the inhabitants of the Dardanu Major and Minor systems.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Half an Amber Era ago, The Family held an unprecedented festival there, and after that... everyone on the planet became part of The Family.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Do you think the same thing will happen on Penacony?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yes, or how else can we explain it? The Family deliberately used the Watchmaker's invitation to keep all the Pathstriders here but banished the Emanator of the Nihility...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Because of the Nihility, I'm rarely affected by the power of other Paths, but somehow I can unconsciously infiltrate them... Maybe that's the "risk" they're trying to avoid.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I would disagree. Byari Skamandros is not part of the credit system or connected to the silver rail. It's nothing more than a remote civilization sheltered by the Harmony... But Penacony is different.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If The Family messes with Penacony, that would be like declaring war on almost half of the factions in the Cosmos. They have no reason to do that.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No, they don't... if they truly serve the Harmony, that is.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: What do you mean?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Path in Penacony is impure. The Harmony here has impurities.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Do you remember the ancient Swarm Disaster? Tayzzyronth the Propagation brought endless havoc to the universe, and it eventually evolved into a fierce battle among all Aeons.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Two Paths lost their Aeons in that war — the Propagation and the Order. Coincidentally, their downfall is related to a certain Aeon...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Xipe the Harmony. Legend has it that THEY participated in the crusade against the Imperator Insectorum and devoured Ena the Order for unknown reasons.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Holy forkeroni... So, you're saying that the two leaderless Paths are working behind the scenes?
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: In the meantime... somewhere at Dreamflux Reef...
But I don't see any descendants of the Propagation in Penacony. Could it be that the remnants of Beyond-the-Sky Choir are hiding within The Family, trying to resurrect a fallen Aeon?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I can't say for sure, but they're definitely planning something for the Charmony Festival.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Holy Wubbaboo! This is getting way too complicated. Is this why you want us to leave Asdana right away? Are you giving up?
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: The Charmony Festival will start soon. There's one thing that... I need to confirm no matter what. A warp jump is the best way to do so.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Time is running out...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I have another plan.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hold on, are you thinking of using the Jade Abacus of Allying Oath?
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Exactly. The assistance from the Luofu Cloud Knights... would be enough.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Think it over carefully. You can only use that once in your lifetime.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: I have considered it thoroughly. My companions are... They're also once-in-a-lifetime treasures.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Are you the only one here, my child?
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: The Nameless is quite the diplomat. Our {RUBY_B#Order}secrets{RUBY_E#} have spread like wildfire within The Family, and IPC starships are gathering towards Asdana...
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: This is a crucial moment for us. So, where is the {RUBY_B#Robin}chosen one{RUBY_E#} who harmonizes the varied sounds?
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: What do you mean, Master?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I'm right here in front of you, aren't I?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You know, she was supposed to be the star of the Charmony Festival in our plan.
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: But the plan has changed. As her brother, I know she doesn't want to sing for the Order, so I'll take her place.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Heh, you've always been wise beyond your years. I'm sure you understand the consequences of your choice.
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: If you consider this a betrayal...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Well, there can't be two suns in the sky. I'll step up and take down the other sun if necessary.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Do you believe in karma?
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: If karma exists, then everyone has their own karma. You have yours, and I have mine.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: And my karma has nothing to do with you, Mr. Gopher Wood.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Alright, since you're willing to sacrifice yourself for her, I'll grant your wish.
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: Well, the compromise came sooner than expected. Why?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You and your sister were born as twins of the Order, and one of you is destined to follow this path to the end.
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: Is this part of your plan?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Of course. You're still as clever as you were when you were a child.
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: The opening is near. Go, my child. Seize the power of the Harmony and reveal your karma.
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: I have one final question, Master.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Why did you choose to bring the Order to Penacony? Wouldn't it have been better to choose a desperate world instead of a city filled with hope and dreams? Why?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: It's for justice, my child.
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: If we lose justice in our hearts, we'll make the same mistake as the Harmony did.
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: So, it's not you who manipulates the Dreamscape with the Stellaron, but...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Well, that's where our conversation ends. Go ahead. The 107,336 souls of the Oak Family have dreamed of this moment too many times...
rows.speaker: "Dreammaster"

rows.text: "I shall ascend to the heavens, becoming the scorching sun."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Bathed in my light, my people shall flourish, while all evil shall be eradicated."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: This is the interior of the Penacony Grand Theater.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It's quite exhilarating to be flushed into the air by SoulGlad, but... why is the venue still closed when the Charmony Festival is about to start?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: And not only that, the entire theater is eerily quiet. No audience, no staff, no one around...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: 4 system hours until Charmony Festival - Astral Express
Even if we're late, a grand theater like this shouldn't be completely empty.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yeah, I wonder how many tickets... Hey, that's not what we should be concerned about!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's explore around. Be careful, everyone.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Gosh, the atmosphere here is so creepy and unsettling...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Even if there's no audience yet, there should be some staff around. Why is it so silent...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yikes! They scared the life out of me! Why are there so many... puppets at the ticket office?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Aaah! Stop it!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Can't believe you're in the mood to crack jokes...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wh—What...? Ah! You're so annoying! Stop scaring me!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Are these puppets part of the stage setup? Even so, it's so eerie that the entire front hall is empty.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Something feels off... We're in the right place, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: There's no other Grand Theater in the Dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So, Sunday is messing with us? He said we'd have a final showdown on the stage, but why is there no one here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "My apologies for the delay, March 7th."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You scared me! Wh—Where... are you now?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "I'm waiting for you behind the curtain. Following the Asdana tradition, I invite you to enjoy a stage play in three acts before the Festival begins."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "History is a mirror reflecting the universe's true essence. Let's use this opportunity to delve into the rich history of Penacony and the Aeons."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Within it, naturally, the future takes shape."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Let us commence with the dawning of the world..."
"After the Dusk Wars, darkness veiled the sky, and chaos consumed the earth."
"Ena the Order emerged, destined to restore all existence."
"That marked the first day."
"THEY gathered nebulae and forged them into picks, thus creating a grand lyre with black and white keys."
"Strike the white keys, and the sun rose. Strike the black keys, and the moon rose."
2 system hours until Charmony Festival - Same Location
"Thus, thirty-one days a cycle, three cycles a solstice, and four solstices marked the passage of time."
"And so, the cycle of day and night arose. That marked the second day."
The puppets are gathering around the frame. Are they expecting us to enter it?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Where are we now?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The atmosphere here... looks similar to Sunday's inner world. Perhaps this so-called "stage play" is created with his abilities.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This act is named Ode to Prisoner. Given the atmosphere here... I believe it's about Penacony's past.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I thought things were finally looking up as I managed to dodge prison during my recent trailblazing expeditions! But now it looks like I'll be back behind bars again...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "I genuinely wish to avoid a violent clash with my esteemed guests from afar. Therefore, I've arranged three acts before the situation becomes irreparable."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Where shall we start our narrative? Well, let's start with the time when Penacony was still a frontier prison."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "This place was once a place of confinement, but we will turn it into a haven of freedom."
rows.speaker: "Past's Voice"

rows.text: "In 2147 AE, a prisoner named Hanunue ignited a struggle for liberty and emerged triumphant. IPC referred to it as the 'War of the Frontier,' while the Asdanians dubbed it the 'War of Independence.'"
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "We've shattered the cages and expelled the guards! But... where shall we go?"
rows.speaker: "Past's Voice"

rows.text: "It's true that Hanunue was a legendary hero, but it must be acknowledged that while he bestowed freedom upon the prisoners, he didn't grant them true liberation."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Thank you for staying here, honorable travelers. However, not even you could banish the guards, though they are no longer in Asdana."
rows.speaker: "Past's Voice"

rows.text: "The three Nameless stayed on the planet, endeavoring to spread the tenets of Trailblaze throughout the frontier prison. Alas, their efforts proved futile."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Let's build another prison, not within the physical world, but within their minds. As long as we keep them imprisoned, they will always have a sanctuary."
rows.speaker: "Past's Voice"

rows.text: "Once again, Asdana was engulfed in war, this time the enemies originating from within. The prisoners remained prisoners for the rest of their lives, fighting for freedom rather than living for it."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "I hope you like this land of freedom... on a scorched earth."
rows.speaker: "Past's Voice"

rows.text: "As you can see, their sentences have long ended, and the IPC guards have long been expelled. Yet, these prisoners remain enslaved, not by external forces, but by the confines of their own minds."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Freedom permeates every corner except fragile souls. It gives solace only to those who believe in its existence."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Prisoners! This is my order! Learn the essence of freedom and teach your fellow prisoners to fight for their lives!"
rows.speaker: "Past's Voice"

rows.text: Hey, why do we have to fight while enjoying the show?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "For I desire not only your enjoyment but also your... assistance in its completion."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "No one can restrain you any more! You are free!"
rows.speaker: "Past's Voice"

rows.text: "Thus concludes the first act. Amidst a raging war, the frontier prison headed toward becoming Land of the Exiles."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: This must be how Penacony was constructed. With the aid of outsiders, the prisoners were finally liberated and established the Land of the Exiles.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: However, it appears that Sunday aims to convey the spiritual plight of the prisoners more than the physical aspects of imprisonment.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Ah, this show is a bit too literary for my taste, but the battle part is quite easy to understand... Anyway, we've arrived at the exit. Let's go!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: These puppets... Where are they guiding us this time?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "THEY transmuted streams of stars into inked nibs, creating symbols to be pronounced and counted."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "THEY molded stardust into flowing rivers, assigning the righteous upstream and the unjust downstream."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Thus, all things were marked, and the world learned to discern between good and evil."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "That marked the third and fourth days."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Look, another frame...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ode to Fool... This must be the second act.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The surroundings are different from before. The stage decorations... look a bit tidier now?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "Behold the ensuing tale, a struggle for power. Penacony witnessed the ascent of the seven major lineages — Tree, Grass, Flower, Bird, Beast, Fruit, and Insect."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Peace never truly graced land of the exiles. The history in this era is rich and intricate, so please allow me to present it in allegorical form."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Welcome to this mansion, dear outsiders. Its founder has been exiled by those beneath them, and now the seven servants believe they can replace their former master."
rows.speaker: Butler

rows.text: "Land of the exiles was in disarray, besieged by both internal and external perils. Though the seven major lineages appeared united on the surface, each harbored their own ambitions, leading to ceaseless conflict."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "My child, you did not serve the old master and know not of his power. Just as he can strip us of our freedom, he can also grant it to us."
rows.speaker: Accountant

rows.text: "The leader of the Alfalfa Family sought to defect to the IPC, trading freedom for survival. However, his eldest son slew him in the name of righteousness and ascended as the new family head."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Those who dance with bees are bound to fall victim to their stings. I have long foreseen my fate, and this moment is inevitable."
rows.speaker: Beekeeper

rows.text: "The Lampmoth Family endeavored to extend the silver rail left by the Express, only to be eradicated by the remnants of the Swarm, leaving nothing in the unforgiving Cosmos."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "As for me... I shall forge new bonds of Kinship and liberate you from the clutches of death."
rows.speaker: New Master

rows.text: "Only when Gopher Wood led The Family to land of the exiles and earned recognition from all five major lineages did Penacony earn its new name, the Land of the Dreams."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Dear outsider, I beseech your aid in purging this mansion of the poison spread by the lurking instigators."
rows.speaker: New Master

rows.text: Uh... You want us to help you? What do you need?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "I wish they could regain their reason and cast away the shackles of hypocrisy."
rows.speaker: New Master

rows.text: This is the second act. Looks like it's about Penacony's journey to becoming the Land of the Dreams, during which The Family plays a crucial role.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But this New Master... seems like a bad guy to me, don't you think?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Perhaps this is the truth Sunday is trying to express, if you read between lines. The Harmony changed Penacony just as the guards once did.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Looks like we've got to help those guys kneeling down over there calm down a bit, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "Where are you headed, dear outsider?"
rows.speaker: New Master

rows.text: Guess we won't be able to leave until this act is complete.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: 1 system hour until Charmony Festival
"Either I shall be my own master, or I shall return to my former master! I shall not submit to a new master under any circumstances!"
rows.speaker: Butler

rows.text: "Master is no longer here. I thought I'd be free, but I'm not. Now without my master's command, I'll have to seek guidance from the blind."
rows.speaker: Advisor

rows.text: "Once, I stood as the most loyal guard among all the servants! Now, with my master banished, it's my right to assume control of his dominion!"
rows.speaker: Retainer

rows.text: "Master! Hope you will return in due course! And I shall stand vigilant, awaiting the reward for my loyalty!"
rows.speaker: Accountant

rows.text: "In the absence of my master I am free, but without their guidance, for whom shall I sing?"
rows.speaker: Artist

rows.text: "Thank you, dear outsiders! My servants have regained their sanity."
rows.speaker: New Master

rows.text: "Heed me, one and all! Your former master shall not return! It is through righteousness and unwavering support for one another that we shall attain true perfection!"
rows.speaker: New Master

rows.text: "Cast aside the veils of hypocrisy! And embrace one another!"
rows.speaker: New Master

rows.text: Get ready. Looks like another fight is about to begin...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Listen, snow blankets all of Asdana! The sky trembles, and the earth teeters on the brink of collapse. At the edge of the silver universe, the first buds sprout under the rising sun!
rows.speaker: "Present's Voice"

rows.text: "Alas, they remain but slaves till the very end, with the illusion of freedom."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Thus concludes the second act. Amidst an illusory harmony, Land of the Exiles charted its course toward becoming the Planet of Festivities."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: This is how Penacony fell under The Family's control. Since the arrival of the Harmony, the land of the exiles has undergone dramatic changes, not all of which have proven... beneficial.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This guy really loves dramatic scenes. Bet he comes from a whole lineage of stage performers.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "THEY used the planetary rings to establish the law, forging a code of conduct among the masses."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "A grand lyre with black and white keys served as an instrument, while symbols of articulation and numerical notation took the form of musical notes. The downward-flowing river became a melody, and the canon of law dictated the form."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Thus, all mortals found their unique place within this symphony. That marked the fifth and sixth days."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: This guy is really into these puppets.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh, I get it now. The last scene is all about singing the praises of the Order.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: And the atmosphere here... is completely different from the previous two scenes.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "This is the concluding act of this play. I have showcased the past and present of Penacony, hoping that my desire for change resonates within you."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: 3 system hours until Charmony Festival - Penacony Grand Theater
"And now, I shall reveal its future to you."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "If the people lack foresight, we will make choices on their behalf and bear the responsibility."
rows.speaker: Chancellor

rows.text: "We shall support one another, protecting the weak and standing against the mighty."
rows.speaker: Chancellor

rows.text: "Before the arrival of a king, everything followed its natural course, and so it shall continue even after the king's departure."
rows.speaker: Chancellor

rows.text: "We no longer have need for a king, for we have become kings of all things."
rows.speaker: Chancellor

rows.text: Hey? Aren't we supposed to kick off a short story and have a fight here just like we did in the previous acts? Why aren't any of these puppets saying anything?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Perhaps we'll need to "complete" the story ourselves just like we did before.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So... [Trailblazer]? Do you think their mind needs tinkering or something?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: How did it go?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You can't change them? What does that mean...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "My apologies for my negligence. I forgot to inform you that the final part... was scripted long ago."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Let our previous king recount it to you. Now, it is time for the final rite."
rows.speaker: "Future's Voice"

rows.text: Prepare for battle. Looks like we'll have to fight again.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "Descending from the infinite spiral staircase, I traverse towards the future with measured steps. No need to remember me or seek my existence, for the contours of my mind shall intersect with other experiences."
rows.speaker: "Ruler"

rows.text: "In the hushed expanse of a nocturnal reverie, I leave faint traces behind. No need to remember me or to recall the essence of dreams."
rows.speaker: "Ruler"

rows.text: "What is mine shall wane, while you shall transcend its delicate nature."
rows.speaker: "Ruler"

rows.text: This is the final scene — it's much more straightforward... He wants to expel the Harmony and establish an empire based on the Order.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Let's go. Once this stage play concludes... it'll be time for the main event — the Charmony Festival.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "THEY imbued the world with meaning, perfecting all things in the heavens and on earth. Then, THEY rested from the labors of creation."
"Yet, all beings cried out to Ena — 'Under the banner of the Order, you have defined all things in the Cosmos... but this made us realize that we are but puppets in your hands!'"
"Thus, on that day, all beings united and cast the Aeon into the abyss of oblivion."
This Grand Theater looks totally different... Is this the power of the Order?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Everyone, get ready. This could be a tough battle.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "That marked the seventh day."
"Cheers and chants reverberated in unison..."
Look! There he is!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That concludes everything related to the Order. What are your reflections on this, my dear guests?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Nevertheless, this is but a trivial blip in the annals of galactic history. What truly matters is the course this river shall take in the days to come...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You've arrived at the perfect moment. The Charmony Festival is about to commence, and it would be a shame if you were absent for {RUBY_B#The Order}the Harmony's{RUBY_E#} prologue.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Allow me to extend my warmest welcome once more. Welcome to Penacony Grand Theater, the very core of the sweet dream, the abode of the Stellaron, the grand stage of the Charmony Festival...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: And... the very place where the future of Penacony shall be determined through conflict.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Your unwavering faith in the Trailblaze is truly impressive.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Because our shared goals give equal weight to the beliefs we strive for.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: It hides behind the curtain. Or rather, it is the theater itself.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: However, if you want to see it, you must display faith equal to its immense power.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: True goodness can only be achieved through faith.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Allow me to point out that falling into a permanent slumber is not happiness, especially when those people are driven by someone else's will in their sleep.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Do you still believe that the Order only seeks to control the universe as THEIR puppet, Himeko?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: No matter how perfect your vision of paradise may be, a cage remains a cage.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: People will never achieve true happiness in a world like that! They would just be toys for the Aeon!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It seems you have misunderstood my intentions. Allow me to clarify — My desire is not to resurrect a fallen Aeon or become one myself...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: My sole objective is to create a paradise free from Aeons, where the Order ensures the dignity and happiness of all humanity. A paradise exclusive to us human beings.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: That's not the case. If people are to live with dignity, there must be nothing and no one above them.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: In your so-called paradise, you would be the one reigning supreme.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Looks like we won't be able to convince each other. Now that our conflict has been destined, let's unveil our Paths and reveal to the universe the true path.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: However, before the prelude to the future begins, please take a moment to ponder the questions I've posed...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Not good. Try to remember. Your name is...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hmm? It does? Well, doesn't ring any bells to me.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Uh... kind of, it was General Jing Yuan who helped us shoot it down.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What happened while I was out?
Are we in the dream or reality?
I... don't remember anything.
Why does that line sound so familiar...
Didn't I shoot the sun out of the sky...
Mm... It's a long story. Simply put, Dan Heng used the jade abacus of allying oath when we were in the middle of a fierce battle, and summoned the general to help us just in time.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Not going to come chat with me... [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: (That voice... Is that Black Swan?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hey, where are you going?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, we meet again, sleepy head.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Wh—What's Miss Black Swan doing here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Though the strike from the General was timely, its destruction was also immense. When Emanators collide, ordinary people inevitably suffer.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: But luckily for them, the {RUBY_B#Memory Zone}Dreamscape{RUBY_E#} is my home turf. Thankfully, I managed to get everyone out before the Harmonious Choir collapsed.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Oh, so that's what happened! Thank you, Miss Black Swan.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't mention it, after all, I wouldn't want to see such precious memories vanish. You're heading to see your friends, aren't you? Would it bother you if I walked with you for a short while?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Of course not... But you're not planning on doing something like last time, are you?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Why would you think that? I've never harbored any ill intentions... well, not when you were around, anyway.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Look, he's still talking to that cowboy!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I... didn't mention anything to him.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Allow me to introduce him to you: This is Boothill, a Galaxy Ranger.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Nah, that ain't it. I just can't seem to recall. Weird, my neuro chip hasn't registered any malfunctions...
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Look, they're with the General!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hahaha, here's the Galactic Baseballer — the paragon of both heroism and humility!
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: No way! Our express is only rated 12+!
Is Himeko's coffee not strong enough for you?
I'll help you ask the conductor.
Hahaha, if it isn't the Galactic Baseballer — a true hero who dares to take action!
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Hahaha, if it isn't the Galactic Baseballer — a hero with unparalleled insight!
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Thanks, {M#brother}{F#sister}! Any low-cost swill will do, I ain't fussy.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: [Trailblazer], are you okay? I heard you couldn't wake up. Are you feeling unwell?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Haha, great.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: What? I can pack it myself, you know...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Haha, good guess!
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Although I'm not too sure of the reason, the representatives from the IPC have insisted on [Trailblazer]'s presence — allow me to lead the way, follow me please!
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Mr. Aventurine and Miss Topaz are here too... And, who is that over there?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The Intelligentsia Guild's Dr. Ratio. This assembly is quite something.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It's been a while, my Astral Express friends.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I would also extend my sincere thanks to you, General of the Luofu. The presence of everyone here assures that the talks will likely reach a conclusion that satisfies all sides.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Oh? Looks like everyone has come with expectations. Care to share?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Of course. Topaz, if you please?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Sure, leave it to me.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: In summary, it's good news — after much deliberation from the Strategic Investment Department's council, the absolute majority of members have agreed to the following resolutions:
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: In the year 2158 of the Amber Era, the first year of the new epoch, the universe resumed its intended trajectory. The kindling of conspiracy smoldered in Penacony, the Land of the Dreams. Failing to erupt into a blaze, it instead flickered briefly on Qlipoth's anvil, before vanishing in the blink of an eye.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The dead and those fated to die remain in their eternal slumber, while the living find solace in deep sleep. All clamored in a cacophony of silence, and then went about their own ways. The cosmos emanated a vitality characteristic of a new era, all for the modest price of a brother and sister's mild grief.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Babies are born as stars extinguish. The silver rail unfolds. The story of the Astral Express comes to a close, yet it also embarks anew.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Time marches forward, heralding the arrival of a new chapter in the history of Trailblazing expeditions.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "In light of long-term considerations for interastral peace, and by authority of Pier Point HQ, the Strategic Investment Department — on behalf of the Interastral Peace Corporation — will permanently relinquish its claim on Penacony sovereignty, and offer unconditional support of The Family's rebuilding efforts on Penacony."
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Uh...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Heh, now that's something.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: "All in the name of peace" — that's our motto.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: To be honest, it does nothing to benefit the IPC... but it is extremely beneficial to the long-term development of the entire universe.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Haha, if that's what it takes to bring peace to the entire universe, it's a price I'll gladly pay.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But... *sigh* Never mind. At the end of the day, this is a positive outcome.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Agreed. It's hard to imagine members of the Genius Society taking an interest in such mundane research...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: (Penacony's journey ends here...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (I guess it was pretty fruitful.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: [Trailblazer], the navigation meeting is about to start. We're all waiting for you!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: (When did the Express become so lively...?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ahem... looks like everyone's present. Let the navigation meeting commence then!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: This a meeting to decide on our next stop? How we doin' this, by show of hands?
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Don't worry, [Trailblazer]'s been up and about for a while now. But hey, Dan Heng, why don't you introduce this cowboy to {M#him}{F#her} first?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hold your horses, cowboy. It's for those to decide.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Hah, I'm just catching a lift. Don't sweat it!
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Shouldn't this be expected of a Memokeeper?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Allow me to explain: Mr. Boothill and Miss Black Swan submitted a request to temporarily travel with the Express for their own personal reasons...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: As you all may also know, the Astral Express never declines any passenger whose heart yearns for the distant stars. Therefore, they will be traveling with us for a while, until they reach their destinations.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Whoa... The Express is going to be much livelier now. But Miss Black Swan, you'd better not use your Memokeeper abilities to pull any pranks!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Understood, Miss March. I promise you, you'll never see me in your room while you're taking a break.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Uhm... Don't, you're freaking me out...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: All right. All right. Now that everyone's met everyone, we can continue our navigation meeting!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Firstly, Pom-Pom wishes to thank everyone. If it weren't for you all unearthing the truth about Penacony, Pom-Pom would have never known where Mikhail and the rest had gone...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: What they had to go through was regrettable, but I reckon they all fulfilled their wishes... And it was thanks to all of you — thank you, everyone.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Now then, we come to the crux of this navigation meeting: We must decide on the Express' next stop! Let me introduce our current options.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: The first choice is from Himeko: The oceanic planet of Lushaka — a planet composed entirely of water. Many aquatic races reside there. Of course, it's also the home planet of the venerable Nameless, Mikhail.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: The second choice is the "Agate World" Melustanin, suggested by Welt. It's famed as one of the initial sites of the Stellaron Disaster and the place where "the Beauty" Idrila ascended. Today, it's celebrated as a planet of undying allure.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: The third choice is Edo Star, a planet nestled within a vast ion storm region, currently under assault by the Antimatter Legion. However, the distress signals from there have recently ceased, prompting the IPC's wish for us to check in on the situation.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: The last choice, courtesy of Black Swan, is the "Glass Belt" Patrevia, a massive belt of asteroids that was turned to glass by the Lord Ravager Zephyro... These days it's apparently known to house one of the branches of the Mourning Actors troupe.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Ooh... So many options. I'm seeing stars already.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Next up, everyone will select the destination that they wish to visit. And then, we'll put it to a vote.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Little Misha and Old Mikhail's homeland... Having been through so much in Penacony, as an aspiring Nameless, I believe a visit to his home world is a must.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Count me in. Still, I imagine that planet must have changed entirely after the Stellaron Disaster. I've heard that its landmasses no longer exist, and the native population has completely changed...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Hmm... I'm not against Miss Himeko's choice, but Edo Star sounds like it's in danger. As Nameless, should we not extend a helping hand?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Three votes for Lushaka, two for Edo...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Looks like we have a winner. Next stop: Lushaka, the ocean planet!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: This trip to Penacony has allowed me to see another side of the Stellaron Disaster... In terms of symbolism, the state of the Dreamscape bears a striking resemblance to the Agate World. Visiting it might deepen our understanding of the Stellaron.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Mm... that makes sense. If that's the case, I vote for the Agate World too.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hmm... I personally think the situation on Edo Star might be more urgent. As Nameless, should we not extend a helping hand?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Three votes for the Agate World, two for Edo Star...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Looks like we have a winner. Next stop: The Agate World, Melustanin!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Though the fact that the distress signals have ceased means we're probably too late... but I still think we should investigate the situation there.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yes, I agree! As Nameless, should we not extend a helping hand?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer] and Dan Heng make good points. I'll throw in a vote for Edo Star too.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: All votes for Edo Star...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Black Swan has arranged to meet a Mourning Actor there. I've heard they're preparing a special performance... I wouldn't mind going to enjoy the show.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That type of performance isn't really my cup of tea, but... I'll let you all decide.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Hmm... I'm really interested to check out this troupe's performance, but it really sounds like the Edo Star is in a lot of trouble. As Nameless, should we not extend a helping hand?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Three votes for the Glass Belt, two for Edo Star...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Looks like we have a winner. Next stop: The Glass Belt, Patrevia!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: If that's the case... How about we go to Edo Star first? If that planet really is in danger, then we should go help them out.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You and Dan Heng make good points. I'll throw in a vote for Edo Star too.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Four votes for Edo Star, one vote abstained...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Then this navigation meeting is adjourned. I'll go check the warp jump coordinates. Everyone can catch up on some rest in the meantime.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: When it's time to make the jump, Pom-Pom will make an announcement!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: (There's still some time before the jump... What should I do?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: [Trailblazer], how about a chat? Over here.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Nothing, Miss March. I noticed [Trailblazer] was awake and wanted to check to see how {M#he}{F#she} was doing.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Please let this trip be uneventful. Please let this trip be uneventful. Please let this trip be uneventful...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Please let this trip be uneventful...
What are you mumbling about?
What's with you and always copying the way I talk!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mumbling!? I'm praying!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The last couple of trailblazing expeditions have been downright terrifying... It's about time we had some fun, cozy, and cute adventures for a change!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Come on, start praying with me! ! Please let this trip be uneventful. Please let this trip be uneventful. Please let this trip be uneventful...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: For some reason, I'm suddenly stricken by the feeling that... we haven't crossed paths in quite some time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It has indeed been a while.
You're always in my heart.
Perhaps... the joy of reuniting after a long time can also be considered just another part of the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...I should have known better than to expect anything serious from you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This time, you must disembark with us when we reach our destination!
Got it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This Astral Express sure is comfy... but, I got one tiny problem with it. How come there ain't no potent drinks on this ride?
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: I can live without malt juice, but at least stock somethin' else! Like that "White Gem," common as dirt and not too pricey.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: You can't use that 12-years-of-age rule against a mighty Ranger like me!
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Uh, well... That's a different kind of "strong"...
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Ha, all these years out in the wild, and now I'm bunkin' in luxury... Gotta say, it's quite the treat.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: [Trailblazer], you're fast becoming an excellent Trailblazer. It's an honor to be able to watch you grow.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Hee-hee, stop flattering me.
Yup, I'm super-duper awesome!

Don't downplay your achievements, everyone has witnessed your growth. I've known many warriors in my time, and only a few achieve the kind of growth you have. Back home, where I'm from you'd be rated at least an S-tier.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yes, yes, you are. I've known many warriors in my time, and only a few achieve the kind of growth you have. Back home, where I'm from you'd be rated at least an S-tier.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It's not been easy for you these past few days. You've earned some downtime. I'm looking forward to seeing how you'll perform on our next journey.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Come to think of it, [Trailblazer], this trip to Penacony was the first time we Trailblazed together, wasn't it?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I hope we can Trailblaze together again someday.
It was too dangerous. I wish you hadn't gone down.
Don't worry. We'll have plenty of time to spend together on the Express, so there'll definitely be more chances for adventures like this.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It's alright! I understand your concern, but it's okay. I'm also a capable Nameless, just like yourself.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Turn in early today. You've really been pushing yourself hard recently. If you don't take this chance to recharge, it could lead to long-term problems... It seems fine when you're young, but it's a different story as you age.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I can feel your obvious excitement... That means your memories will also become even more beautiful.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: That tinge of regret I sense... Ah, these are the kinds of lasting memories I cherish.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: There's a rich scent of curiosity here... Such memories can be irresistibly captivating.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: March is right. Though the fact that the distress signals have ceased means we're probably too late... but I still think we should investigate the situation there.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Ah, such an intense emotion... Heh, makes you break out in a sweat, but you just can't get enough.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Oh? Such elusive emotions... I've never encountered memories quite like this before, it's stirred my curiosity.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: So... How about you hand that "small parting gift" back to me? I'm quite eager to have it back.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Hmm, never mind...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: March is right. Though the fact that the distress signals have ceased means we're probably too late... but I still think we should investigate the situation there.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Precisely. But, do you know the deeper meaning behind it?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: How adorable. But, do you know the deeper meaning behind it?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The memories I have of you are not enough for me to predict a future that lies too far ahead.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The reason is simple: In this grandiose and ostentatious dream of The Family's, only you personally experienced the entire course.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: If that's the general sentiment, then we should indeed investigate. I vote for Edo Star too.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Patience, my friend. I will reveal the answer to you... but that time is not now.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Looks like we have a winner. Next stop: Edo Star!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: "Life is akin to a winding labyrinth, where memories serve as our sole companions."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Countless shooting stars streak the sky tonight... If you can pick the right one, it will carry your wish to thousands of distant worlds.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: March is right. Though the fact that the distress signals have ceased means we're probably too late... but I still think we should investigate the situation there.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You're feeling very relaxed now, aren't you? So then...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It's time to tell you a little bedtime story.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: March is right. Though the fact that the distress signals have ceased means we're probably too late... but I still think we should investigate the situation there.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Heh, little Misha... or should I call him the Watchmaker?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: If that's the general sentiment, then we should indeed investigate. I vote for Edo Star too.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Sparkle — yes, Sparkle, the most enigmatic and elusive character in the entire story. But unfortunately, she was the first to uncover the truth, and she did purposefully attack you to create confusion.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Looks like we have a winner. Next stop: Edo Star!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Well, although the fake "deaths" of those two ladies don't align with our initial assumptions, this fact itself doesn't contradict the information we have so far.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Are you suggesting that {RUBY_B#IX, the Nihility}the sleeping and shapeless{RUBY_E#} never bestows its gaze upon anyone, and thus no one can truly possess the power of the Nihility?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It's true that Gallagher is a History Fictionologist, but he didn't lie in this matter. In addition, "death" and "dormancy" do arise from the same concept, don't they?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Not another one...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Thank you so much, Black Swan.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Finally, I can breathe a sigh of relief.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: What happened?
What is this place?
The déjà vu is strong with this scene...
I understand you must be confused, and we'll do our best to shed light on the situation. However, before that, it's essential to know that...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This place is the rift between dream and reality. A place reserved only for those who have awakened from Ena's dream.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Do you remember Sunday's ambitious plan? He intended to harness the power of the Stellaron, the collective will of over 100,000 Oak Family members, and the desires of everyone in Penacony to usurp the Harmony and restore the Order.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Unfortunately, it didn't stop there. From the early days of our journey into Asdana, we were already affected by the Stellaron. That strange Dreamscape where we met... Maybe it was a sign that your thoughts were beginning to drift away.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I don't think... the goal of the Order was to put everyone into a deep sleep. Quite the contrary — they used the Stellaron to catalyze the leakage of Asdana's memoria into the material world, allowing the Dreamscape to blend with reality.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...And that included a lot of memoria from the Beyond-the-Sky Choir. As time came and went, the dreams eventually became indistinguishable from reality, and reality became an illusion. People think they are awake, but their spirits have long since stepped into the temple of Order.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Whatever we're facing, I'm prepared.
This is what makes Ena's Dream so powerful. In this paradise governed by the Order, everyone indulges in their delightful dreams and lives happily ever after.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I believe what you experienced in the sweet dream, except for that flaw, was real. Only in this way could you reach the destination, lifting the crisis in Penacony and embarking on your next trailblazing expedition.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: If it wasn't for Acheron's plan, we might have been trapped in this dream forever.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I'm not quite ready yet...
Very well. Now, please close your eyes...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That's alright. Take your time to contemplate this moment. Once you feel ready, let's step onto the final stage.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: As I said, our plan is not about convincing everyone to choose the right path, but about inspiring them to save themselves. So, when will people actively save themselves?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Fortunately, while the Path of the Order governs all things, it can't affect the Nihility. I came to realize this when the Dreammaster tried to expel me at any cost.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This is also why you felt a sense of peculiarity when traveling with her.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Well, I'm not as fortunate as she is. Even if I'm a Memokeeper, I was still influenced by the power of the Order and fell into hallucinations.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: However, thanks to your memories, now we still have a chance to turn the tide.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: For mortals, even if they possess the great power of a Path, they can't create a flawless world like Gods do.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Very well. Now, please close your eyes...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That's alright. Take your time to contemplate this moment. Once you feel ready, let's step onto the final stage.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: If there is a vast, lifelike dreamland that is virtually indistinguishable from reality... a realm without death, where everyone can attain the happiness and fulfillment they deserve, living blissfully ever after.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Imagine if this splendid dream were fated to fall apart: Friends, family, strangers... followed by the gentle breeze, soaring birds, the stars... and ultimately, yourself.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I'm glad. The answer itself doesn't matter. What matters is that you've made a decision.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That's why there was a flaw in your dream. In other words, once you have realized the world is not real, you'll have a chance to break free from the dream.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The flaw in your dream lies within Misha, who could have never appeared in reality. When I turned the pages of your memories, I realized that I was in an illusion, too.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Now Sunday has usurped the power of the {RUBY_B#Shared Wish's Harmonious Embodiment}Harmonious Choir{RUBY_E#} through the Charmony Festival. Asdana has thus fallen into Ena's Dream, transforming everyone equally into the {RUBY_B#puppets}notes{RUBY_E#} of the Aeon.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Failure doesn't mean weakness. Only the strong can gather the will to resist the Order and try to break free.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: We still have a chance, though. To make it happen... please, Black Swan, guide us to those with a strong will.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Alright, please come with me.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: These people are...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: They're the ones who accept Ena's Dream and indulge in their happy illusions...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: We have no means to wake them up now. Not even your clockwork will do the trick.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: However, there are still other things we can do. Let's keep going.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Here we are.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: (It's... Robin?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Finally, you've arrived.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Let me introduce you to Robin. She woke up from Ena's Dream by her own will, and it's this tough lady who led us here with her song.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I woke up for the same reason as all of you. In the dream, I experienced something that could never occur in reality...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Are we going to lock it up in a cage? I want to see it fly freely in the sky.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Without us, this bird would be too fragile to survive on its own. Do you want it to die?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: No, but...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Then let's take care of it together until it can return to the sky.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...Huh?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Birds have wings because they're meant to fly. Even if they may crash on the ground one day, they shouldn't be trapped in a cage.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Birds belong to the sky, so we should help them return there, right?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...The illusion was so impossibly blissful that I realized it was just a dream.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: And this is our final hope. Ena's Dream is founded upon the Harmonious Choir, namely everyone's shared wishes. It will only materialize once the aspirations of all beings in Penacony merge as one.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: At present, it has become impervious due to people's desire to remain slumbering within the dream. And in order to destroy it...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: We must make everyone in Penacony want to wake up.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Now comes the tricky part. How do we do it?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You want to go back? Unfortunately, human consciousness always gravitates toward reality. Now that you've seen the flaw in the dream, there is no turning back.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Humans' yearning for sweet illusions borders on obsession, leading them to subconsciously resist... the harsh reality.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: However, to wake up everyone in Penacony and get them to share the same determination... that would be nearly impossible.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Indeed. I'm afraid it's almost as difficult as resurrecting an Aeon...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: But we can't just stay here and do nothing.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This is a critical moment for the whole universe! Who cares about some dumb number?
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Thanks to Black Swan.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You're welcome. And thanks to the Memokeepers in Penacony, too. I believe your partners... have also awakened from their dreams.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: This is the first step of our plan. With the assistance from the Garden of Recollection, those who possess a strong will, like you, will gradually awaken from the dream. These free wills are the "discord" that will sway Ena's Dream.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: However, awakening a mere handful of individuals is insignificant compared to the vast number of people immersed in the dream. We must find other ways to awaken the free will of millions of people within a short period of time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If breaking through from the inside proves challenging, we can seek assistance from the outside. We've long been aware of a potential solution.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Asdana is a galaxy known for its abundant memoria and the remarkable phenomenon known as Synesthesia Dreamscape. When people first enter this place, they often find themselves and others sharing a collective dream...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: At this very moment, there is only one dream encompassing the entire Asdana system.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: So you mean, if we can attract a large number of outsiders to this system, their free will would intertwine with this dream and shake it to its core...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: However, those outsiders might also succumb to the dream and become the foundation of the Order instead. The real challenge is — How can we gather a huge number of people as determined as you within a short period of time?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Looks like the Jade Abacus of Allying Oath will be the only solution.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...No, no need for that.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Keep your once-in-a-lifetime treasure. We don't need to bother the Xianzhou Alliance for such a tiny request. You want thousands of people with unwavering free will? Hah, that's easy...
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Just leave it to us Galaxy Rangers.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: You can gather Galaxy Rangers?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hah! Outsiders may see Galaxy Rangers as elusive and disconnected individuals, and actually... they're right! And that's why we have a tacit understanding among us...
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Do you know what it is, Acheron?
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: It's the relic I returned to you.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Exactly. Its owner must have told you that it's meaningless to anyone other than a Galaxy Ranger, and that it can only fulfill its purpose when returned to its rightful owner.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Because it's a burial artifact, worthy only of a hero who has served the Galaxy Rangers with honor. When its light illuminates the universe, it means the fall of a hero, and in the direction it falls...
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Countless meteors will streak across the sky. Those "meteors" are Galaxy Rangers coming from all corners of the Cosmos, driven by a shared purpose, without questioning the cause or counting the cost. Because we abide by a bottom line...
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: The shooting stars of The Hunt only descend on the longest night, and with them... comes the dawn.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: We've stayed silent for far too long. Now, it's time to remind all the cowards, oppressors, and villains of the universe of our presence! I'll be the one to ignite the first spark.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Once the Dreamscape is swayed, I'll complete the second step. I'll fine-tune the slumbering souls with the song of the Harmony, interrupting them with the discord of "Trailblaze" and guiding them towards reality.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: It's true that some people are born strong, and others are born weak. If the Trailblaze is the target of heroes, then the Harmony will guarantee that the strong help the weak. Only the people of Penacony themselves can be the saviors of their homeland.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Their path of happiness should be forged by themselves. While I may not be a Nameless, I'm willing to instill courage in all those who need it.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: This includes my brother as well. Ena's Dream... is too cruel for him, and everyone else.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Your plan sounds well-conceived, but still, it appears somewhat... idealistic and romantic. The flaws rooted in human nature can't be eradicated overnight. Do you believe these efforts alone are enough to convince everyone to choose the right path?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I agree with you, Black Swan. That's why the most critical aspect of this plan is not to convince everyone to choose the right path...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...But to inspire them to save themselves.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Now that our roles are assigned, let's get to our battlefields and pose a grand finale!
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Therefore, I carefully selected a moment where [Trailblazer] was completely unguarded, guiding {M#him}{F#her} to uncover the truth {M#himself}{F#herself} to make {M#him}{F#her} regain {M#his}{F#her} consciousness.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I have faith in you. However, before we depart, there is one more thing I must tell you.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Indeed, she was the first to discover the world beyond the shores of "death" and shared this truth with all of us.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Only by reflecting on our steps can we remember the path we should be walking on... and the companions who have walked alongside us.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: There's something you should know. We were able to locate you within this boundless dream and find the key to breaking free from the dream, all because of one person's unwavering dedication...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: We mustn't fail her determination. I'm not implying that we must win this fight no matter what, but our resolve should match that of the courageous lady.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Always distinguish between reality and imagination... alright, Gray?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: May your schemes... be forever concealed.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Ena's Dream... is too cruel for him, and everyone else.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: To the imperfect tomorrow.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: I still remember the question on the invitation letter — Why does life slumber?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Why does life slumber...? We don't know the answer yet, but we're about to awaken from this dream.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Or perhaps, such is the answer itself.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Leave this place, return to where you belong, and... awaken Penacony from this dream.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The answer is... when they are in desperate situations.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Like a drowning individual in the deep sea, when one's body and mind bear immense pressure, agony, confusion, and despair will follow. I firmly believe that...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The fragility of humankind often freezes them in their tracks, but in truly desperate situations they will strive to save themselves. And now... Penacony has enough heroes to lead them forward.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It's through this inherent self-centered instinct that people exert their utmost effort, even when they know their struggle is fruitless. As absurd as it may seem, it's their resistance.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: As for now, [Trailblazer]... It is time to guide them, not as a savior, but as a Nameless among those mortals.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: In this way, you will reunite in the warmth of the sunlight.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The rain... is intensifying. Before we part ways, please allow me to ask a few final questions.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: So far, you have forged unbreakable bonds with numerous individuals and entities in the sweet dream.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Might I ask if you fear severing these bonds with your own hands?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I would ask — Would you wish to stay?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Everyone, and every face they remember, the joy and the heartaches, the vows sealed and those left hanging... all will inevitably march towards a predetermined ending. If you had grasped the journey's finale right from its inception...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I would ask — Would you still embark on this journey?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Listen, touch, and ponder, and therein lies the sensation. Cherish it, because that's what makes us exist. Such is the only answer humans can offer when facing the Nihility.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: In the first year of the AE 2158, a fiery conspiracy erupted in the Land of the Dreams, but soon faded in chaos and destruction.

Whispers carried the tale of those fateful 48 system hours, when a sun teetered on the precipice of collapse, a paradise stood on the brink of destruction, and a world was poised to surrender to its new master. Amidst it all, a body decayed, a pack of vultures gathered, and a brother and sister were doomed for long separation.

And so, an Aeon succumbed to slumber once more. Some celebrated this fall, while others mourned. Among the insignificant witnesses, mere specks in the vast tapestry of the universe, it was said that this time, the Aeon met THEIR demise with dignity.

As the Cosmos bathed in the radiance of a pure dawn, a tempestuous storm brewed on the horizon. The chant of "All for the Amber Lord" grew ever louder. Yet, no matter how one contemplates it, time inexorably swings Qlipoth's colossal hammer in eternal cycles.
The tale of the Astral Express reaches both its conclusion and a new beginning. Time marches forward, heralding the arrival of a new chapter in the history of Trailblazing expeditions.
If the Nihility represents the primal fear of life, rendering any lofty convictions insignificant under THEIR imposing shadow...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Then behind this shadow, there must exist the most fervent source of light in the world.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Just as every life that edges closer to death fervently approaches the end of the Nihility...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: We must pursue that primordial light.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Now come to think that you exist in the Nihility, and you watch over others to depart it...
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: Such a task is absurd and meaningless.
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: Nevertheless, someone has to do it. As for the meaning you mentioned...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Even if it's a meaningless task, I've come this far, haven't I?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Even if the future you forge may not even belong to you?
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: It may not belong to me, but it definitely belongs to someone.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: What hardships you must have experienced...
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: In that case, allow me to do something meaningless, too...
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: Please tell me your name.
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: Perhaps my existence will vanish in the next moment... and nobody will remember this conversation or your answer...
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: But I believe... that your name should be remembered...
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: And this universe... will remember it as well.
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: For me, some things are difficult to recall, yet there are others... that I find challenging to forget.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Such is "memory," a creation of the past that blossoms into significance in the distant future.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I remember that marks the start of my journey, the origin of the vibrant red hue in my life, and the most fervent element amidst every tempest...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Will you come with us?
As I said, our plan is not about convincing everyone to choose the right path, but about inspiring them to save themselves. So, when will people actively save themselves?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: What if folks don't wanna wake up?
Will I get to witness your hidden power?
I feel no fear.

If there is a vast, lifelike dreamland that is virtually indistinguishable from reality... a realm without death, where everyone can attain the happiness and fulfillment they deserve, living blissfully ever after.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I would never ever want to live in a dream.
Imagine if this splendid dream were fated to fall apart: Friends, family, strangers... followed by the gentle breeze, soaring birds, the stars... and ultimately, yourself.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I would blaze a trail without hesitation.
I'm glad. The answer itself doesn't matter. What matters is that you've made a decision.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: How long... has this rain been ongoing?
If I remember correctly, it has lasted for decades, or even centuries.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The unwavering determination of The Hunt followers persists even in death, but thankfully... we've guided those lost souls to their lives beyond. They were heroes in their time, and they won't be reduced to puppets of the Nihility in their death.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You see, the shadows on the sea have vanished. Do you remember? You once said that the sky would clear when the regrets of the departed had faded away.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: But it's still raining...
...I know.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: So, why is all this...?
Why did this rain choose me?
Because someone's regrets haven't been fulfilled, perhaps.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Mortals who walk the Paths are like sailors on a vast ocean, leaving behind a trail that creates countless ripples of possibilities. These ripples last longer than the fleeting lifetimes of humans.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: And for some, their presence leaves such a strong mark that it's reflected in the waves.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Sin Thirsters... the obsessions of the Pathstriders. They emerge from the depths of IX, seeing themselves as masters of their own destiny, unknowingly repeating the actions of their past lives.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: They emerge from the Nihility and head toward it, leading purposeless lives. However, these hollow phantoms...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: They have journeyed with me for such a long time.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That's my name...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: So, this is how it is.
I... I'm already dead.
...Yes.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Are you watching over me?
This is my duty... as the watcher of the Acheron.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I'm guarding the path to the abyss of the Nihility, guiding every soul reluctant to become one with it... back to this side.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: But if this is what the departed ones expected, should you try to change it?
I don't know, but someone once told me that when the inevitable moment came, he hoped that...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Someone would stand at his grave and place a bouquet of flowers.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Even if... it doesn't make sense at all?
Some tasks have to be done, even if they are pointless. I have... experienced that much already.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Please extend your hand, and then close your eyes.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I'll carry your wish with me and fulfill it. Only then will I be able to put an end to the final regret by the Dead Sea.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Will I... ever see them again?
Yes — that is certain.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Because it was you who told me about the Express, your two former companions, the expedition cut short by the Swarm, your narrow escape from death, and your encounter with the Galaxy Rangers...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: And Penacony, the hometown to which you could never return.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Yeah, for countless times... I got rejected by The Family and had to pass it by.
But I knew that my companion was still there... alone...
Mikhail... Are you still there...?
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: Take my hand and come with me. We... will leave this place.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You'll embark on a long, long journey, shrouded in darkness. But fear not, as a touch of red will be awaiting you at the end of the path.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That's the color of "existence." Follow it, and it'll guide you and illuminate the way out. By doing so, you'll eventually reunite in the warmth of the sunlight.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Thank you...
rows.speaker: "Tiernan"

rows.text: May death be the end of your boundless dream...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...guiding you back to the waking world.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Welcome to Horizon of Existence...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This place is one of the thousands of manifestations belonging to {RUBY_B#IX, the Nihility}the sleeping and shapeless{RUBY_E#}, and it's also an exit out of the Nihility for the awake ones.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Let's bid our final farewells here.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Raiden Bosenmori Mei.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Brother, do you think... the stars will fade away?
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: Where did that come all of a sudden?
rows.speaker: Trustful Boy

rows.text: Because the constellation that looks like a bird, the... Torrent Eagles... looks a bit dim lately.
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: It's the Torment Eagles. Don't worry, it's still there. It's just it's located in the inner ring of Penacony and can only be seen when spring and summer overlap.
rows.speaker: Trustful Boy

rows.text: As for the question you asked... I think stars do die, just like people.
