rows.speaker: Trustful Boy

rows.text: But do you know, sister? No star actually belongs to the present. The light we see from them is from a long time ago.
rows.speaker: Trustful Boy

rows.text: Even after the stars perish, their light will travel millions of light-years, spanning countless years, to illuminate the night sky of another world.
rows.speaker: Trustful Boy

rows.text: In our paradise, I believe there will be a star like that, shining with the same light. Its radiance will last "forever," and its name... will be "happiness."
rows.speaker: Trustful Boy

rows.text: No, not just one star! We should have two stars... or maybe even more!
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: Yeah, you're right.
rows.speaker: Trustful Boy

rows.text: It's a deal!
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: It's a deal, then. This is our promise, and nothing will sway our ideals.
rows.speaker: Trustful Boy

rows.text: Yeah, you bet!
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: It's a pleasure to hear your voice again. Congratulations, you've become the... biggest winner of this festival.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Are you just calling to poke fun at me?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: No, I'm just impressed. Not only did you venture alone into Penacony and discover the truth of Dreamflux Reef, but you also managed to escape with the help of that Knight of Beauty...
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Remember the recording you received from your Trailblaze friend? It's now the most valuable chip in this game.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: However, this came at a high cost... Losing a Cornerstone is a hefty price to pay. Diamond just called a meeting to discuss what to do with you.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Just as I expected. So, is Diamond planning to demote me, or kick me out of the Ten Stonehearts?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Why don't you take a wild guess?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Well, alright. Then I'll guess... he's going to promote me to P46?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Alright, what will you wager?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Are we talking about an actual bet here? I don't wanna wager anything just so that you can swindle it all in the end.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But if it's just a friendly bet, I'll put on the line what I did when we first met. I'll bet my life, ma'am.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Interesting. But since it's Diamond's call, no one can predict the outcome.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I'm on my way to Penacony. Once everyone is settled, we'll return to Pier Point for the final showdown.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Sounds like I'll be out of the action for a while. Finally, a chance to kick back and relax?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Yeah, leave everything to me and Topaz, child. Thanks to you, as soon as the Jade Stone was delivered to The Family's compound, we finished up our preparations.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: The seeds we planted have taken root. Soon... it'll be time to "reap" the rewards.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: ...Huh?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Let's wrap it up for now. Looks like I've got a visitor here...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Oh? So many surprises today. Didn't expect a Galaxy Ranger and wanted criminal to show up here...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...One who managed to take out two IPC members under the noses of our fleet. Do you understand what that means?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Screwubbaboo, I just put them to sleep! Don't try to intimidate me with that nonsense. Besides, I've taken down more IPC lackeys than the residual value you've squeezed, and I don't mind adding a few more zeroes to my wanted poster.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: I have a question for you. Be honest now, or I won't think twice about puttin' a bullet in your fudgin' head.
rows.speaker: Boothill

rows.text: Tell me... Where is {RUBY_B#Head of Marketing Development Department}Oswaldo Schneider{RUBY_E#}?
rows.speaker: Boothill
